name: Salesforce
description: Salesforce is a leading customer relationship management (CRM) platform that enables AI agents to manage customer data, track sales pipelines, automate service operations, and interact with enterprise business objects.
auth_evidence_snippet: REST API client applications must authenticate before making any other API requests. Client applications typically use OAuth 2.0 or Connected Apps to authenticate.
access_evidence_snippet: Sign up for a free Salesforce Developer Edition environment to build, test, and integrate.
api_evidence_snippet: Salesforce offers comprehensive APIs including REST API, SOAP API, Bulk API, Composite APIs, and Connect REST API to access data and metadata.
buildability_blocker: Requires setting up a Salesforce Developer Edition account and configuring a Connected App with appropriate OAuth scopes.
notes: Salesforce provides robust enterprise APIs with extensive developer tooling. Building agent toolkits requires handling Connected App configuration and navigating object-level permissions, but developer accounts are freely accessible.

name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot is a customer relationship management (CRM) platform that provides tools for marketing, sales, content management, and customer service.
auth_evidence_snippet: Private apps are a simple way to authenticate your integrations in HubSpot. Instead of going through the full OAuth 2.0 flow, you can generate an access token for a private app and use it to make requests to the HubSpot APIs.
access_evidence_snippet: To start building on HubSpot, you need a HubSpot account. You can create a free account to get access to a free CRM and developer sandbox.
api_evidence_snippet: HubSpot offers robust REST and GraphQL APIs covering Contacts, Companies, Deals, Tickets, and more.
notes: HubSpot provides free developer accounts with full access to standard APIs, making integration building very accessible.

name: Pipedrive
description: Web-based Sales CRM and pipeline management tool designed to help businesses plan sales processes and track deals.
auth_evidence_snippet: Pipedrive API uses OAuth 2.0 for authentication and personal API tokens for quick access.
access_evidence_snippet: Try it free. No credit card required.
api_evidence_snippet: Comprehensive REST API covering deals, leads, organizations, persons, activities, and more with 100+ endpoints.
notes: Pipedrive offers robust self-serve developer access via a trial account, with public documentation for both OAuth2 and personal API tokens, as well as comprehensive REST endpoints.

name: Attio
description: A flexible, data-driven CRM platform that lets you build custom workflows, manage relationships, and sync data via an extensive API.
auth_evidence_snippet: Attio uses OAuth 2.0 to allow third-party applications to access user data. You can also generate internal integration access tokens (Bearer tokens) for testing and private applications.
access_evidence_snippet: Get started for free with our Free plan. No credit card required.
api_evidence_snippet: The Attio API is a fully-featured REST API allowing you to manage objects, records, lists, notes, tasks, and more.
notes: Attio provides a comprehensive self-serve developer platform with robust REST endpoints and official documentation supporting OAuth2 and token-based authentication.

name: Twenty
description: An open-source CRM platform that helps teams manage their customer relationships, sales pipelines, and business data.
auth_evidence_snippet: You can authenticate your API requests by providing your API key in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.
access_evidence_snippet: Open Source: Free forever. Self-host with Docker. Cloud Free: Free for small teams.
api_evidence_snippet: Twenty provides a powerful GraphQL API to query and mutate your CRM data.
notes: Twenty is fully open-source with both a self-hosted option and a cloud tier, offering robust REST and GraphQL APIs accessible via API keys/Bearer tokens.

name: Podio
description: Podio provides a flexible platform for organizing team communication, business processes, data, and content in workspaces.
auth_evidence_snippet: All interaction with the Podio API must be authenticated. Podio uses OAuth 2.0 for authentication.
access_evidence_snippet: To start building on the Podio API, simply create an account on Podio and register your application.
api_evidence_snippet: The Podio API is structured around REST. Our API allows you to access and manage workspaces, apps, items, comments, and more.
notes: Podio provides a comprehensive REST API and standard OAuth2 authentication accessible directly through self-service developer registration.

name: Zoho CRM
description: Comprehensive cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) software for managing sales, marketing, and customer support.
auth_evidence_snippet: Zoho CRM APIs use the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication and authorization.
access_evidence_snippet: To work with the Zoho CRM APIs, you need a Zoho account. You can sign up for a free developer account or a trial account.
api_evidence_snippet: Zoho CRM REST API v6 provides methods to access and manage modules like Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Deals, and more.
notes: Zoho CRM provides extensive developer documentation, a robust REST API (v6), webhooks (Signals/Webhooks), and a self-service developer edition signup making it fully buildable today via OAuth2.

name: Close
description: Inside sales CRM software designed to help businesses manage leads, communicate via calls, emails, and SMS, and track sales pipelines.
auth_evidence_snippet: The Close API uses HTTP Basic Authentication. You can generate an API key from your Close settings and use it as the username with a blank password, or use OAuth2.
access_evidence_snippet: API access is available on all Close plans. You can sign up for a trial or free account and immediately generate an API key from your settings.
api_evidence_snippet: The Close API provides comprehensive coverage of Leads, Contacts, Opportunities, Activities, Tasks, Custom Fields, and more across multiple REST endpoints.
notes: Close offers an extensive REST API with robust documentation, supporting standard API keys and OAuth2 for integration development.

name: Copper
description: A CRM built specifically for Google Workspace that integrates tightly with Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive to manage relationships and pipeline.
auth_evidence_snippet: All requests to the Copper API must be authenticated. You can authenticate using an API key and user email, or via OAuth 2.0.
access_evidence_snippet: Try free for 14 days. No credit card required.
api_evidence_snippet: Comprehensive REST API covering People, Companies, Opportunities, Tasks, Projects, Leads, and Custom Fields.
notes: Copper provides well-documented REST APIs and standard authentication mechanisms, making it straightforward to build integrations.

name: DealCloud
description: A deal management, relationship management, and CRM platform tailored for capital markets, investment banking, private equity, and real estate.
auth_evidence_snippet: DealCloud APIs require authentication via OAuth2 or API keys depending on the endpoint and integration configuration.
access_evidence_snippet: DealCloud does not offer self-serve free trials or signup; prospective users must contact sales for enterprise licensing.
api_evidence_snippet: DealCloud provides robust REST APIs for integrating third-party applications and managing entities, lists, and data entries.
buildability_blocker: Requires a paid enterprise DealCloud account and administrator approval to provision API credentials.
notes: DealCloud is an enterprise-grade platform by Intapp. API documentation and access are strictly gated behind enterprise agreements, requiring direct contact with sales.
human_needed_reason: Requires contacting sales to obtain an enterprise developer account and API access credentials.
